title: Kicker and team-defense season projections
description: K and DEF projections on their OWN contract, deliberately NOT merged into player_projections.json: that file publishes projected[:300] and its 300th offensive player scores 38.8, while kickers project 130-195 and D/ST 100-185 — merging would silently evict ~74 offensive players from Players, the draft board and every VOR pool. Produced by scripts/build_kdst.py from nflverse stats_player_week / stats_team_week plus nfldata games.csv SCORES ONLY. Validated by scripts/validate_data.py.

updated_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the last regeneration.

seasons_used.description: Completed seasons the projection was actually built from. A season whose feed failed is ABSENT here and present in `skipped` — never silently replaced with zeros.

games_projected.description: Games a projected season contains. Per-game rates are multiplied by this.

recency_weights.description: {season(string): weight} applied to BOTH numerator and denominator of the per-game rate.

modelled_keys.description: Scoring keys this file DOES populate, by position. Anything not listed here and not in unmodelled_keys is simply not a key this app knows.

unmodelled_keys.description: HONESTY CONTRACT. Scoring keys that are genuinely unmodelable from this source. They are ABSENT from every `stats` object rather than scored as zero, so a total built from `stats` is knowingly partial. The UI must render a PARTIAL SCORING marker from this list.

reason.description: Why it cannot be derived. Must name the missing source, not hand-wave.

weekly_split.description: R55: how the D/ST weekly split was built, and why kickers have none. Parameters are MEASURED by scripts/backtest_kdst.py walking 2023-25 forward; the gate refuses any change that does not beat the flat season average it replaces.

teams_split.description: Defenses that got a weekly list; 0 means the schedule was unreadable and every row kept the flat average.

neutral_weeks.description: Weeks whose opponent had no surrendered-points history, taking factor 1.0. Counted rather than hidden: a neutral week is an absent signal, not a measured one.

league_allowed_pg.description: The league-wide surrendered rate the per-team ratio is taken against.

kicker_reason.description: The measured reason kickers carry no split.

partial_scoring.description: Per position: true when unmodelled_keys contains at least one key for it.

skipped.description: Every season, game or row dropped, with a reason. A missing source is skipped LOUDLY here — never fabricated and never silently zeroed.

kickers.description: One row per kicker projected for `season`. Only kickers who played in the newest season used appear.

player_id.description: nflverse gsis_id for a kicker; 'DST-<TEAM>' for a team defense.

weighted_games.description: Denominator of the per-game rate after recency weighting.

low_sample.description: True when weighted_games < games_projected — a small-sample extrapolation the UI must mark rather than rank silently.

stats.description: Projected season counts per scoring key. Keys are app/league.js SCORING_FIELDS keys (plus the Sleeper yds_allow_* family, which league.js keeps and applies as an unknown key). A key in unmodelled_keys is ABSENT here on purpose.

proj_points.description: sum(stat x points-per-stat) under app/league.js DEFAULT_PROFILE scoring. Recompute from `stats` with applyScoring(stats, profile) for a real league. NOT a scale factor applied to anything.

weekly.description: R55: ALWAYS null on a kicker, and that is a measured result rather than an omission. Over the same walk-forward grid the D/ST split clears, the best kicker configuration moved MAE by -0.008 +/- 0.014 (not significant) and every stronger setting made it worse (scripts/backtest_kdst.py). A kicker week is season / games and app/kdst.js keeps labelling it a season average.

defenses.description: One row per team defense (32 when every season loaded).

player_id.description: nflverse gsis_id for a kicker; 'DST-<TEAM>' for a team defense.

weighted_games.description: Denominator of the per-game rate after recency weighting.

low_sample.description: True when weighted_games < games_projected — a small-sample extrapolation the UI must mark rather than rank silently.

stats.description: Projected season counts per scoring key. Keys are app/league.js SCORING_FIELDS keys (plus the Sleeper yds_allow_* family, which league.js keeps and applies as an unknown key). A key in unmodelled_keys is ABSENT here on purpose.

proj_points.description: sum(stat x points-per-stat) under app/league.js DEFAULT_PROFILE scoring. Recompute from `stats` with applyScoring(stats, profile) for a real league. NOT a scale factor applied to anything.

weekly.description: R55 weekly split: one entry per week this defense plays, or null when the split could not place the team on the schedule (it then keeps the flat season average). FACTORS, never points: the split is computed under the DEFAULT profile while app/kdst.js prices under the LEAGUE's, so only a dimensionless multiplier survives that difference. The factors of a team average exactly 1.0, which IS the statement that the season total is unchanged and only the weekly shape moved.

week.description: Regular-season week. A bye is ABSENT from this list, never a zero entry.

opp.description: Canonical opponent abbreviation for that week.

home.description: True when this defense is at home; the home tilt rides on the same multiplicative footing as the opponent factor.

factor.description: Multiply the flat season average by this. clamp(1 + shrink x (opponent surrendered rate / league rate - 1)) x home tilt, then normalised so the team's factors average 1.0.
